description: This file appears to be a header file defining a C++ wrapper class (`GLibWraps`) around some GLib functions, along with an abstract implementation class (`GLibWrapsImpl`). It declares methods for checking if a main loop is running and for connecting/disconnecting signal handlers, possibly providing an abstraction layer for GLib interactions to facilitate mocking or testing.

classes.name: GLibWrapsImpl
